chunks: 7 – Al-Ḥasan ibn al-ʿAbbās ibn al-Ḥarīsh, al-Rāzī, Abū Muḥammad. Weak. Narrated from Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī (peace be upon him) "The Virtue of 'Verily We have made it descend on the Night of Power'" a compiled book of corrupt expressions, (its characteristics bear witness to it being forged). And this man is not to be regarded, and his ḥadīth is not to be written.

key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ: Weak (a narrator whose reliability is questionable)

ai.seo_question: Who is Al--Hasan ibn al--Abbas al-Razi and what is his status in hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This biographical entry from *Kitab al-Du'afa* evaluates the narrator Al--Hasan ibn al-Abbas al-Razi as weak. It notes that he narrated a book titled 'The Virtue of the Night of Power' which has corrupt expressions and is likely forged, leading scholars to disregard his narrations.
